class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/ControllerStuckEvaluator
class.description: Diagnoses a robot commanded to move ("cmd_vel" above threshold) that is not making progress (robot_pose barely changing). Skips evaluation while a recovery mitigation owns control_owner, while any safety reflex is intervening, or without an active goal.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/NoPathEvaluator
class.description: Diagnoses a missing or empty planner path: WARN if the planner has not published one yet, ERROR if it published an empty path, OK otherwise.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/ObstacleTooCloseEvaluator
class.description: Diagnoses the robot being stopped (near-zero measured velocity) too close to an obstacle. Deliberately compound: it does not fire while the robot is still moving/braking.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/RosGraphEvaluator
class.description: Checks EasyNav's wiring in the ROS graph: ERROR (hardware_id "ros_graph") if a subscription of an EasyNav node has no publisher, or if no velocity output of EasyNav has a subscriber. OK reports whether the velocity output is consumed stamped or unstamped.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/SafetyChannelEvaluator
class.description: Reports protective stops of the safety channel ("safety_status") as WARN, and as ERROR once one lasts max_stop_time seconds, so a mitigation (e.g. asking for human assistance) can handle it.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/AdvanceRecovery
class.description: Advances a short configured distance for diagnostics with hardware_id "controller_stuck" (ControllerStuckEvaluator). Never reports success as "fixed" — each activation just completes one advance; if the same episode keeps recurring for too long in total, it gives up and escalates instead of retrying forever.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/CancelMissionRecovery
class.description: Mission-level last resort: accepts any ERROR diagnostic no other mitigation resolved (or already gave up on), and requests GoalManager to cancel the active mission, reporting the diagnostics that caused it. Does not take control_owner — see docs/recoveries_easynav_implementation.md, Fase 5.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/HumanAssistanceRecovery
class.description: Last-resort, generic mitigation: accepts any ERROR diagnostic, holds the robot stopped and makes the problem observable, and resumes normal operation as soon as no diagnostic is left at ERROR level. Does not fail the mission (see docs/recoveries_easynav.md §5.15).

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/SafeRetreatRecovery
class.description: Retreats straight back from a too-close obstacle (hardware_id "obstacle_proximity") until reaching a safe distance. Fails safely if the obstacle is behind the robot instead of ahead of it.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/ShutdownRecovery
class.description: System-level mitigation for unrecoverable diagnostics (by default hardware_id "ros_graph"): stops the robot, cancels the active mission and requests EasyNav to terminate in an orderly way, reporting the diagnostics that caused it.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/CollisionSafetyReflex
class.description: Level-0 (real-time) safety reflex that stops the robot when the forward-projected "cmd_vel" would cause a collision within the current braking distance. See docs/recoveries_easynav.md, level 0.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/DummyEvaluator
class.description: A "dummy" implementation for RecoveryEvaluatorBase. Always reports OK. This evaluator does nothing. It serves as an example and a reference plugin.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/DummyMitigation
class.description: A "dummy" implementation for RecoveryMitigationBase. Accepts any non-OK diagnostic and immediately reports SUCCEEDED. Serves as an example and a reference plugin.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/DummySafetyReflex
class.description: A "dummy" implementation for SafetyReflexBase. Never intervenes unless its "trigger" parameter is true, then stops the robot. Serves as an example and a reference plugin.
